About Resident guide Where to spend Contact us Frequently asked questions (FAQ) Resources Enhanced Climate Friendly Households Programme (CFHP) Launched on 28 November 2020, CFHP aims to encourage households to be more efficient in their energy and water consumption, while saving on utility bills in the long run.
